{{translated title}} ---- [[File:Pokémon Mezastar Aim to Be a Tag Master.png|thumb|250px|Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンメザスタ　メザせ！タグマスター}}''' ''Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] by [[Kemon Kawamoto]]. It was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine from the January 2021 issue (released on November 21, 2020) to the February 2024 issue (released on December 21, 2023). It is based on the arcade game [[Pokémon Mezastar]]. It tells the story of Kira Hoshio. ==Characters== * '''Kira Hoshio''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|星|ほし}}{{ruby|尾|お}}キラ}}''' ''Hoshio Kira''). He is the main character. He debuted in [[MTM01]]. * '''Suguru Tsukino''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|月|つき}}{{ruby|野|の}}スグル}}''' ''Tsukino Suguru''). He is Kira's classmate. He debuted in [[MTM01]]. * '''Douji Futakata''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|双|ふた}}{{ruby|方|かた}}ドウジ}}''' ''Futakata Douji''). He debuted in [[MTM05]]. * '''Rekuto Kuroko''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|黒|くろ}}{{ruby|子|こ}}レクト}}''' ''Kuroko Rekuto''). He collects strong tags. He debuted in [[MTM07]]. * '''Mirai''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ミライ}}''' ''Mirai''). He is a streamer. He debuted in [[MTM13]]. * '''Kanon Tenou''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|天|てん}}{{ruby|桜|おう}}かのん}}''' ''Tenou Kanon''). She debuted in [[MTM15]]. ===Gallery===
